description: Profile observable speaking mechanics and convert scripts into quantified Seedance prompts while preserving dialogue exactly.

com.openai.default_prompt: Whose speaking style should I profile?

capabilities: Delivery profiling, exact-script segmentation, and Seedance prompt generation
defaultPrompt: Profile the delivery mechanics of a public speaker, then prepare my script for Seedance.
Analyze only pace, pauses, emphasis, gestures, eye contact, framing, and energy from this speaker.
Use the saved delivery profile to split this exact script into 10-second Seedance prompts.
interface.longDescription: Analyze observable speaking mechanics such as pace, pauses, emphasis, eye contact, gesture timing, framing, and energy. Then divide an exact user script into quantified Seedance prompts of up to 10 seconds without describing a real person’s identity, appearance, clothing, location, or voiceprint.

com.openai.long_description: A skills-only workflow for analyzing observable speaking mechanics and segmenting scripts into quantified Seedance prompts without describing identity, appearance, or voiceprint.
com.openai.short_description: Analyze delivery mechanics and build Seedance prompts.

name: speaker-delivery-profiler
